d:
U.S. President Donald Trump said Washington was in no hurry to reach a deal with Iran as Tehran pursued diplomatic efforts to prevent a renewed conflict.
Iran has proposed a seven-day plan involving the lifting of the U.S. blockade and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, while Qatar is mediating between the two sides.
With the U.S. midterm elections approaching, both Washington and Tehran are preparing for the possibility of renewed military action.
